-- Get CAS and location pairs for each reagent to include L-450A explicitly
WITH deduplicated AS (
  SELECT cas_number, name, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id || ':' || location, '|') as lots_info
  FROM reagents 
  GROUP BY cas_number, name
)
SELECT cas_number, name, total_quantity, lots_info
FROM deduplicated
WHERE cas_number = 450 OR lots_info LIKE '%L-450A%';

-- Build CSV payload for deduplicated reagents
WITH deduplicated AS (
  SELECT 
    cas_number,
    name,
    SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
    GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id || ':' || location, ',') as locations,
    row_number() over (order by cas_number) as row_num
  FROM reagents 
  GROUP BY cas_number, name
)
SELECT 
  'cas_number,name,total_quantity,locations' ||
  CHR(10) ||
  GROUP_CONCAT(
    '"' || cas_number || '","' || name || '","' || total_quantity || '","' || locations || '"'
  ) as csv_payload
FROM deduplicated;
